aisha_cs: Hey team — putting together a short customer-facing runbook for Geomate's go-live tomorrow. Focus: caching, batching, streaming, and a small fallback plan for renewal-risk customers. Can you skim and flag anything risky?

marco_ops: sharing the draft now. quick note — they expect high burst traffic initially (spike around 10k req/min).

aisha_cs: copy. primary goals: reduce token cost, keep p95 < 350ms, and capture enablement feedback.

marco_ops: Runbook outline below. Feel free to paste into the customer doc.

marco_ops: 1) Warmup & prefill
- Run a 2-hour warmup: 5 concurrent users ramp to 200 over 30m, then sustain 1k RPS for 30m.
- Prefill: precompute top 10 common prompts + embeddings.

marco_ops: 2) Caching
- Enable prefix KV cache at edge for identical prefixes (TTL 30m).
- Use response-level dedupe for near-identical results (hash the prompt+params).
- Monitor cache hit rate; target >= 60% within first 24h.

marco_ops: 3) Batching & concurrency
- Client SDK: enable dynamic batching with max_batch_size=16, max_wait_ms=12
- For high-throughput routes, set parallelism=4 per model instance.
- Fallback: if queue depth > 500, route to a cheaper quantized variant.

marco_ops: 4) Streaming & graceful degradation
- Prefer streaming for interactive flows to get tokens out early.
- If model latency > 800ms for >5% requests, auto-fallback to non-streaming short responses (summary-first).

marco_ops: 5) Telemetry & alerts
- Track: p50/p95 latency, cache hit rate, tokens per request, avg batch size, stream byte/sec.
- Alert: p95 > 500ms for 5m, cache hit < 30% for 15m, error rate > 1% 10m.

marco_ops: 6) Enablement checklist (what CS/AE should do with customer)
- Walk product team through prefill and warmup plan.
- Share short checklist for engineers: enable batching in SDK, configure TTL for cache.
- Get agreement on fallback policy for model variants.

marco_ops: 7) Feedback capture
- Add a quick in-app survey after first 1k successful sessions.
- Capture qualitative notes via shared Google Sheet + weekly CS sync.

marco_ops: config snippet for SDK:
```
client.config({
  batching: { max_batch_size: 16, max_wait_ms: 12 },
  cache: { prefix_ttl_s: 1800, dedupe: true },
  streaming: true,
})
```

priya_ae: This is great. A couple asks from sales: can we mark which steps are mandatory for the SLA vs recommended?

aisha_cs: Good call — i'll bold mandatory steps in the customer doc. Mandatory: warmup, batching enabled for high-traffic routes, telemetry hooks. Recommended: aggressive cache TTL tuning, in-app survey.

sam_eng: One technical note: for their on-prem deployment we need to flip KMS for embedding prefill. Also, dynamic batching max_wait_ms=12 might be tight on CPUs; consider 20ms if they run on CPU-only nodes.

marco_ops: updated note: if infrastructure==cpu-only then max_wait_ms=20, max_batch_size=8.

priya_ae: Renewal-risk tranche: can we add an SLA-driven safety net — like a short token subsidy or burst credits during first 30 days?

aisha_cs: yes, propose a 2-week burst credit + weekly health check. we'll include that as a renewal play.

sam_eng: Also adding a quick fallback snippet for the routing policy:
```
routing: {
  primary: 'redwood-reliable-v1',
  fallback: ['redwood-quant-2x', 'redwood-cost-opt'],
  policy: 'latency_then_cost'
}
```
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: runbook-doc updated at 1768301320 by marco_ops :memo:

marco_ops: last check — monitoring dashboards: i've attached links in the doc to p95 latency dashboard + cache hit dashboard.

aisha_cs: perfect. final step: Priya, can you run the customer-facing walkthrough with Geomate at 09:00 PST tomorrow? I'll own the health check cadence.

priya_ae: yes, booked with them. sending calendar invites now.

aisha_cs: thanks everyone — i'll push the runbook to the customer doc and add the mandatory checklist. :raised_hands:

marco_ops: leaving a quick TL;DR for the customer doc:
- Warmup / prefill first.
- Enable batching + streaming.
- Turn on prefix cache (TTL 30m).
- Routing fallback to quantized model under load.
- Weekly health checks + in-app survey during initial 2 weeks.

priya_ae: looks good. closing the thread after go-live check-in tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
